draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.99, the 134th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 14th of 22 at LB. He went 103rd overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (134th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: Micah Kiser. Testing standouts: vertical jump (82nd percentile). Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (13th percentile), three-cone (0th percentile). College production: 86 tackles in 2020, 8th of 22 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Seattle Seahawks. 78 career games and 63 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (17 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: passer rating allowed 54.0 (100th percentile), approximate value 17 (99th percentile), passes defended 7 (94th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 off-ball linebacker who played: 126 combined tackles against a median of 66, above the norm.
